channel.title: Summa in a Year
channel.description: Hi, my name is Austin Habash, Founder of Think Catholic, and you're listening to the Summa in a Year Podcast, where we study St. Thomas Aquinas’s Summa Theologiae in a way simple & insightful for anyone to understand. The Summa in a Year Podcast is brought to you by Think Catholic. Taking 2 questions of the Summa of a Day; we'll seek to summarize St. Thomas’s responses, discovering the brilliance of Aquinas and his Catholic Faith.

item.title: Day 307: You Made It.
item.description:
In this episode, we cover question 99 of the Supplement to the Summa, and questions 1 and 2 of the Appendix I & the articles of Appendix 2 which is: Of God's Mercy and Justice towards the Damned & Of the Quality of Those Souls Who Depart This Life with Original Sin Only and Of the Quality of Souls Who Expiate Actual Sin or Its Punishment in Purgatory and Two Articles on Purgatory
